subtitle: Health Confusion to Next Step
purpose: Help users organize health concerns and identify a safer next step without diagnosing or prescribing.
problem_statement: People often feel confused about symptoms, urgency, and what information to share with a healthcare professional.
solution: CarePath AI converts an everyday health description into a plain-language summary, follow-up questions, urgency guidance, a doctor-visit summary, a symptom-tracking plan, and multilingual support.
limitations: Does not prescribe or change medication
Does not replace a qualified healthcare professional
Must not be used as a substitute for emergency services
